confusable_pairs: A. 情绪(1,点状) vs 氛围(3,面状)：指到某一瞬间→情绪；贯穿整场指不到哪一秒→氛围。可并存。
B. 视点(4) vs 共情(7)：调认知位置/从谁看→视点；调情感亲近/道德站队→共情。反事实：换成讨厌的角色，效果还在→视点，消失→共情。
C. 角色内心(5.2,看懂角色) vs 心智化(7.3,卷入推断)：把心理展示清楚→5.2；促观众主动推断并投入→7.3。
D. 情绪紧张(1.2,感受态) vs 悬念(8.3,信息焦灼)：情绪绷紧、未必有明确结果→1.2；对某未来结果的焦灼→8.3。
E. 揭示(8.1) vs 情境交代(9)：揭开被隐瞒的真相→8.1；提供本就该给的环境/背景→9。
F. 好奇(8.2) vs 悬念(8.3)：谜在过去/已存在→好奇；焦灼在未来结果→悬念。
G. 氛围正向(3.5-3.8,面状) vs 情绪正向(1.5,点状)：贯穿整场的暖/欢底色→氛围；某一刻高兴→情绪。

top_intents.definition: Evoke a specific, punctual emotional response in the audience to the present moment.

sub_intents.name: Fear/Terror
sub_intents.definition: Trigger an immediate reaction of fear, threat or panic.

sub_intents.name: Tension/Anxiety
sub_intents.definition: Create a taut, anxious emotional tension (an affective state, not informational suspense).

sub_intents.name: Disgust/Aversion
sub_intents.definition: Arouse physical or moral disgust and rejection.

sub_intents.name: Sadness/Melancholy
sub_intents.definition: Arouse low, sorrowful, rueful feeling.

sub_intents.name: Joy/Delight
sub_intents.definition: Arouse positive feeling: joy, lightness, delight.

sub_intents.name: Anger/Indignation
sub_intents.definition: Arouse anger, grievance, righteous indignation.

sub_intents.name: Awe/Sublime
sub_intents.definition: Inspire awe, shock, a sense of being transcended.

top_intents.definition: Control where the audience looks inside the frame; emphasize or downplay specific elements.

sub_intents.name: Emphasize subject/detail
sub_intents.definition: Focus the gaze on a specific subject or detail.

sub_intents.name: Guide gaze path
sub_intents.definition: Choreograph the path and landing points of the gaze.

sub_intents.name: De-emphasize/Hide
sub_intents.definition: De-emphasize or hide secondary information so the key point stands out.

sub_intents.name: Attention redirect
sub_intents.definition: Hand attention from A to B within one shot.

top_intents.definition: Build an enveloping, sustained emotional ground and psychological state for the whole scene.

sub_intents.name: Tense/Oppressive/Ominous
sub_intents.definition: Sustain a pressuring, ominous, unresolved tension.

sub_intents.name: Unease/Instability/Vertigo
sub_intents.definition: Sustain ongoing imbalance, disorientation and vertigo.

sub_intents.name: Gloomy/Sorrowful
sub_intents.definition: Sustain a low, sorrowful ground across the whole scene.

sub_intents.name: Mysterious/Solitary/Detached
sub_intents.definition: Create an atmosphere of mystery, isolation, detachment and unfamiliarity.

sub_intents.name: Warm/Cozy
sub_intents.definition: Create an intimate, healing warm ground.

sub_intents.name: Romantic/Lyrical
sub_intents.definition: Create a romantic, lyrical, poetic atmosphere.

sub_intents.name: Cheerful/Light
sub_intents.definition: Create a cheerful, lively, light atmosphere.

sub_intents.name: Serene/Peaceful
sub_intents.definition: Create a serene, soothing, tranquil atmosphere.

sub_intents.name: Dreamlike/Surreal
sub_intents.definition: Create a dreamlike, trance-like, unreal texture.

sub_intents.name: Immersive/Absorbing
sub_intents.definition: Strengthen the sense of being inside and drawn into the space.

sub_intents.name: Authentic/Documentary
sub_intents.definition: Create a documentary, unpolished sense of the real.

top_intents.definition: Arrange the audience's viewing position and stance (whose eyes we see from, whom we side with).

sub_intents.name: Subjective/POV
sub_intents.definition: Make the audience see through the character's eyes and identify.

sub_intents.name: Objective/Neutral observer
sub_intents.definition: Present from a non-aligned stance; the audience stays a non-involved observer.

sub_intents.name: Omniscient/God's-eye
sub_intents.definition: Provide an omniscient vantage above any single character.

sub_intents.name: Alignment modulation
sub_intents.definition: Modulate the audience's viewpoint identification with / closeness to a character.

top_intents.definition: Convey a character's status, inner state, motivation and relationships (dimension + value; emotion/relation share value sets).

sub_intents.name: Power/Status
sub_intents.definition: Make the audience judge a character's strength and dominance.

sub_intents.name: Inner/Emotion/Motivation
sub_intents.definition: Let the audience read the character's emotion, mental state and motivation.
sub_intents.note: dimension; affective values shared with audience emotion

sub_intents.name: Character relations
sub_intents.definition: Present closeness, opposition, connection and isolation between characters.

sub_intents.name: Personality/Identity
sub_intents.definition: Make clear who the character is (identity / occupation / personality).

top_intents.definition: Organize the speed and rhythm of time via camera movement / action / editing (per shot: movement & action speed; sequences: editing density).

sub_intents.name: Accelerate/Urgent
sub_intents.definition: Use fast camera moves / quick internal action / rapid cutting for urgency and high energy (shot or sequence).
sub_intents.note: bipolar axis; fast<->slow; per shot: movement/action speed

sub_intents.name: Slow/Stagnant
sub_intents.definition: Use slow camera moves / slow motion / long held shots for calm and release (shot or sequence).
sub_intents.note: bipolar axis; fast<->slow; per shot: movement/slow motion

sub_intents.name: Show passage of time
sub_intents.definition: Imply a span of time or a segment transition.

sub_intents.name: Rhythm sync/Emotion curve
sub_intents.definition: Make the audience's rhythm follow the film's rhythmic curve.

top_intents.definition: Narrow the emotional and psychological distance between the audience and the character.

sub_intents.name: Intimacy/Closeness
sub_intents.definition: Shorten the psychological distance to the character; build intimacy.

sub_intents.name: Emotional involvement/Resonance
sub_intents.definition: Deepen emotional investment in and resonance with the character's situation.

sub_intents.name: Mentalizing/Understanding character
sub_intents.definition: Prompt the audience to actively infer and understand the character's mind.

sub_intents.name: Sympathy/Moral alliance
sub_intents.definition: Bring the audience morally to the character's side, caring about their welfare.

top_intents.definition: Control the audience's knowledge relative to the character to create curiosity / suspense / surprise (reveal / hide / delay / mislead are the means layer).

sub_intents.name: Reveal/Clarify
sub_intents.definition: Reveal the truth to the audience and resolve questions (knowing).

sub_intents.name: Curiosity
sub_intents.definition: Desire to investigate something past that was withheld.

sub_intents.name: Suspense
sub_intents.definition: Anxious anticipation of an unknown future outcome.

sub_intents.name: Surprise
sub_intents.definition: Shock caused by an unexpected revelation.

top_intents.definition: Establish the time, place, scene and background in which the action happens.

sub_intents.name: Establish place/time
sub_intents.definition: Establish the scene's location, time, era and environment.

sub_intents.name: Establish scene geography
sub_intents.definition: Give the audience a cognitive map of who is where and how positions relate.

sub_intents.name: Convey background/context
sub_intents.definition: Provide the background information needed to understand the plot.

top_intents.definition: Express size, scale and positional relations between subject, environment and characters.

sub_intents.name: Subject-environment relation
sub_intents.definition: Present the relation and proportion between subject and environment.

sub_intents.name: Tiny/Engulfed
sub_intents.definition: Make the person appear spatially tiny, engulfed by the environment.

sub_intents.name: Scale/Magnitude
sub_intents.definition: Convey the scale, magnitude or grandeur of an object or space.

sub_intents.name: Inter-character spatial relation
sub_intents.definition: Present spatial positions and distances among multiple characters.

top_intents.definition: Create balance, tension and visual beauty of the frame through composition and formal rules.

sub_intents.name: Balance/Stability
sub_intents.definition: Create balance, stability and unity of the frame.

sub_intents.name: Imbalance/Visual tension
sub_intents.definition: Create visual tension, energy and instability through composition.

sub_intents.name: Formal beauty/Interest
sub_intents.definition: Pursue beauty, harmony and visual interest of the frame.

sub_intents.name: Authorial style/Unity
sub_intents.definition: Express an author/director style through consistent formal choices.

top_intents.definition: Convey theme and ideas beyond dialogue through visual metaphor and symbolism.

sub_intents.name: Visual metaphor/Symbol
sub_intents.definition: Use visual elements to carry metaphor and symbolic meaning (incl. theme reinforcement).

sub_intents.name: Motif/Recurring imagery
sub_intents.definition: Thread a recurring image/color through the work to reinforce meaning.

sub_intents.name: Demarcate narrative segments
sub_intents.definition: Use visual differences to demarcate or mark narrative segments.
